name: Yogurt with coconut tapioca
summary: Sữa chua trân châu is the Hạ Long cup: yogurt the stall cultured itself, with warm coconut-milk tapioca poured over the cold cup. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, both place it in the city for about ten years at those writings.
origin: Hạ Long. Both accounts call it a local sweet, not a recipe from another city.
taste: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls the cup cold, the coconut sweet and rich, and the tapioca chewy.
howToEat: The yogurt is soft and has no ice crystals. The tapioca is white, clear, and chewy, cut in short pieces, sitting in coconut milk the stall made. Pour the warm coconut tapioca into the cold yogurt.
VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, both printed 10,000–30,000 đồng a cup. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, repeats that range. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, does not print a street. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, names Văn Lang and Trần Quốc Nghiễn. A current door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Sua chua tran chau — Ha Long yogurt and coconut tapioca
seoDescription: Sữa chua trân châu is cold cultured yogurt with warm coconut-milk tapioca. The 2019 and 2021 cups were 10,000–30,000 đồng. A current price is Check on arrival.
